Reclaim energy, rebuild simple habits

Free guide: "7 Micro-Habits to Steady Your Day" — download when you book a discovery call.

Why this approach works

I blend habit science with human-centered design: small, repeatable actions stacked into routines that preserve momentum. My coaching centers on what you can build into your real schedule, not a list of 'shoulds.' With compassionate accountability and tools to track progress, clients sustainably shift how they feel and perform.

— {{COACH_NAME}}, {{CREDENTIALS}} in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}}

Learn my philosophy

Core Framework — The 4 Pillars

Designed to move habits from intention to identity with measurable progress each week.

1. Anchor Habits

Small rituals anchored to daily cues that stabilize mornings and evenings.

2. Energy Ecology

Micro-adjustments to nutrition, movement, and rest that fit busy schedules.

3. Progress Loops

Weekly reflection + tweak sessions to ensure momentum without burnout.

4. Identity Shift

Language and habits that align behavior with the person you want to be.

Programs — Pick a Path

Each path blends coaching calls, habit templates, and accountability tailored to your life stage.

Starter Rhythm

A focused 8-week plan to stabilize sleep, mornings, and midday energy. Best for busy professionals starting habits.

  • 4 coaching sessions
  • Weekly habit tracker
  • Email check-ins
Explore
Resilience Builder

12-week progressive work to increase stress resilience and anchor restorative breaks into your day.

  • 8 coaching sessions
  • Mindfulness and movement mini-courses
  • Priority messaging
Explore
Habits to Identity (VIP)

6-month bespoke partnership for sustained life redesign — ideal for leaders and creatives wanting deep change.

--bg:#0f0f10;--card:#0f1720;--muted:#aeb6bf;--accent:#ffd166;--accent-2:#7bd389;--glass:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);--radius:12px;--max:1100px;--mono:Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, .container{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:32px} .header-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between} .brand{font-weight:700;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-size:1.1rem} .nav{display:flex;gap:18px} .nav a{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:8px} .nav a.cta{background:var(--accent);color:#071019;font-weight:600} .nav-toggle{display:none;background:none;border:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:1.4rem} /* HERO */ .hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 420px;gap:40px;align-items:center;padding:60px 32px} .hero-media img{width:100%;max-height:420px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 8px .hero-actions{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-top:18px} .btn{display:inline-block;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:10px;text-decoration:none;color:#fff;background:transparent;border:1px solid .btn.large{padding:16px 22px;font-size:1.05rem} .meta{color:var(--muted);font-size:0.9rem;margin-top:8px} /* Story */ .story-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr .pillar{background:var(--glass);padding:18px;border-radius:12px} .pillar h5{margin:0 0 8px} /* Programs */ .program-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:18px} .program-card{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,0.02),rgba(255,255,255,0.01));padding:20px;border-radius:14px} .program-card h5{margin:0 0 8px} .program-card ul{padding-left:18px;color:var(--muted)} /* Pricing */ .pricing-grid{display:flex;gap:16px;margin-top:12px} .price-card{flex:1;padding:18px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.02)} .price-card.featured{box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03)} .price-card .price{font-weight:700;font-size:1.2rem;margin:8px 0} .pricing-note{color:var(--muted);margin-top:12px} /* Testimonials */ .testimonials{padding:40px 0} .testi-carousel{position:relative;height:140px;overflow:hidden} .testi{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);transition:all .5s ease;color:var(--muted)} .testi.active{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)} .testi cite{display:block;margin-top:10px;color:#fff;font-weight:600} .testi-controls{margin-top:12px} /* CTA */ .cta-area{padding:40px 0} .cta-card{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(123,211,137,0.06),rgba(255,209,102,0.03));padding:28px;border-radius:14px;text-align:center} /* Footer */ .site-footer{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03);padding:28px 0;margin-top:48px} .footer-grid{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px} .footer-nav a{display:block;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none} .credits{color:var(--muted);margin-top:12px;text-align:center} /* Responsive */ @media(max-width:980px){ .hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:18px} .story-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;} carousel var carousel = document.getElementById('testiCarousel'); if(carousel){ var items = Array.from(carousel.querySelectorAll('.testi')); var idx = 0; if(items.length) items[0].classList.add('active'); function show(i){items.forEach(function(el,j){el.classList.toggle('active',j===i)});} document.getElementById('prevTesti').addEventListener('click',function(){idx = (idx-1+items.length)%items.length; show(idx);}); document.getElementById('nextTesti').addEventListener('click',function(){idx = (idx+1)%items.length; show(idx);}); // auto-advance setInterval(function(){idx=(idx+1)%items.length;show(idx);},7000); } // Smooth scroll for internal anchors document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(function(a){
